Subject: Mutual success plan & onboarding timeline — Acme Energy

Hi Jordan / Priya —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Per our conversation, I’m sharing a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a suggested onboarding timeline so we can align on milestones, owners, and go/no‑go dates. Our goal is to have a production-ready inference route for your customer support assistant by the end of Q2, with an initial pilot in a controlled environment by mid‑May.

High-level proposal (draft):
- Pilot scope: 3 high-volume support flows (billing, outage, account changes) integrated into your Zendesk private app.
- Pilot window: 2 weeks of live traffic after configuration and validation.
- Production target: 2026-06-30 (end of Q2).
- Success metrics: < 250ms median generation latency, >= 95% inference uptime, acceptable ROUGE/QA baseline vs. current responses.

Attached: AcmeEnergy_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP with milestones & owners), Onboarding_Checklist_Acme.pdf (technical pre-reqs), Network_Questions_Acme.docx (security/network items).

Next steps I suggest:
1) Confirm roles below (we’ve cc’d CS & SE).
2) Please review the MAP and mark any date conflicts by next Tue, 2026-02-24.
3) Kickoff: propose 2026-03-02 for a detailed implementation kickoff (60m). I’ll send a calendar invite when we agree.

If you prefer a different cadence or want the pilot scope expanded/contracted, tell us and we’ll iterate.

Thanks,
Sean

--
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Sean —

Thanks, this looks sensible and aligns with what we discussed. A few notes from our side:
- We can commit to the pilot scope but would like to add a lightweight user feedback loop in week 1 of the pilot.
- Security wants answers to the network questions before kickoff; we’ll aim to return that doc with comments by 2026-03-01.
- Our preferred kickoff is 2026-03-03 at 11:00 PT (Jordan and I both available).

I’ll confirm formally after Jordan checks with the engineering lead for the Zendesk integration.

Best,

Folks —

I’ll take the Customer Success (CS) lead on this engagement. Proposed internal owners and responsibilities (we’ll share in the MAP):
- Customer Success (Marissa Cole) — onboarding project manager, weekly check-ins, success criteria sign-off.
- Solutions Engineer (Evelyn Hart) — integration design, test plan, pilot validation, post-pilot tuning.
- Sales Engineering (Dev Patel) — initial env setup, performance tuning, runbook handoff.

Marissa: I’ll prepare a two-page kickoff agenda and a short RACI matrix for the MAP.
Evelyn: please review the Network_Questions_Acme.docx and flag anything that needs our infra team.
Dev: can you draft the initial runbook snippets for Zendesk auth config by 2026-03-02?

Sean: please confirm the kickoff time with Jordan/Priya and lock the calendar.

Marissa

Jordan / Priya —

Thanks for the quick confirmations. Per Priya’s note, we updated the MAP with the CS kickoff agenda, RACI, and a lightweight user feedback plan for pilot week 1. Key milestones (updated):

- 2026-03-03 11:00 PT — Implementation kickoff (60m) — attendees: Acme engineering, Priya, Jordan; Redwood: Marissa, Evelyn, Dev, Sean.
- 2026-03-02 — Dev to provide Zendesk runbook snippets (Dev Patel). (Note: moved earlier to enable kickoff review).
- 2026-03-09 — Env configuration complete; Redwood to run smoke tests.
- 2026-04-06 — Integration E2E validation & security sign-off window (2 weeks for fixes).
- 2026-05-15 — Pilot start (2 weeks live traffic + feedback).
- 2026-06-30 — Production go‑live target (post-pilot review + SLA handover).

I’ve uploaded the updated MAP to the shared Drive (link below) and attached the latest MAP v1.1 to this thread. Please review the specific owner assignments in the RACI sheet and highlight any edits.

Calendar: I’ve sent a calendar invite for the 2026-03-03 kickoff to all cc’d.

Thanks — looking forward to kickoff.

Sean
